limitation: Original import manifests and retained captures are not bundled. These assessments are research context, not imported requirements. No verified open power package in this source set.

assessments.name: Stibnite
assessments.signal: Camp installation is active; ATCO announced a 1,052-person camp with Q1 2027 operation. Permanent grid equipment was still being procured/delivered in September 2026. Whether camp energization precedes adequate utility supply is unknown.
assessments.buyer: Perpetua project team; Hatch controls major procurement. ATCO holds the housing contract. Public vendor-intake route exists.
assessments.action: First qualification conversation. 2G only if gas/propane is permitted and deliverable. MW, duration, package boundaries and award status are unknown. Idaho Power powerline-materials package is already contracted.

assessments.name: Hermosa
assessments.signal: Utility states existing distribution cannot meet anticipated demand. South32 reports existing temporary self-generated natural-gas power; 138 kV transition is advancing.
assessments.buyer: South32 Hermosa; Worley for underground and surface non-process engineering/procurement; Sundt for defined construction scopes.
assessments.action: Ask only about incremental load, fleet extensions or replacement scope. Existing supply defeats an assumption of an unfilled prime-power need. Natural-gas fit is plausible, but permit equipment configurations and engineering remain unresolved.

sources.label: South32 April 30, 2026 announcement reproduced by Listcorp

assessments.name: Rhyolite Ridge
assessments.signal: Planned self-sufficient steam turbine may still require independent startup/commissioning supply. August newsletter makes FID dependent on partnering, economics and Board approval.
assessments.buyer: Ioneer and Fluor; Hyundai procurement role under non-binding 2026 MOU needs reconciliation.
assessments.action: Early planning watchlist. No temporary-power load or tender verified. ABB announced permanent steam-generation, electrical distribution and automation scope: do not pitch that as unawarded.

assessments.name: Thacker Pass
assessments.description: Thacker Pass, Nevada — Lithium Americas / GM JV
assessments.signal: Early utility commissioning in H2 2026; grid energization targeted Q4 2026.
assessments.buyer: Lithium Americas operations-readiness team and Bechtel EPCM.
assessments.action: Only residual commissioning/contingency loads merit a question. August update says off-site power work complete and procurement above 80%; no demonstrated grid delay or open generation package.

assessments.name: Eskay Creek
assessments.signal: More than 70% complete August 31; initial production targeted Q2 2027. Pre-commissioning and permanent energization form part of remaining scope.
assessments.buyer: Skeena engineering/construction team. Andrew Osterloh is publicly identified as VP Project Engineering & Construction; contracting authority unverified.
assessments.action: Late-stage contingency watchlist. March release reports 88% procurement costs committed and BC Hydro tap-in complete. Residual power, fuel and cross-border 2G logistics remain unknown.
